name: {{ .service }} · availability
description: Share of non-5xx server spans. Owner: {{ .team }}. Generated from observability.yaml; do not edit in the UI.

customSli.indicator:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "{{ .service }}" and span.kind == "server"
| makeTimeseries { total = count(), bad = countIf(http.response.status_code >= 500) }
| fieldsAdd sli = 100 * (1 - bad[] / total[])
